source_scope: Pawlowski & Traenkle, Phys. Rev. D 110, 086011 (2024), arXiv:2309.17043v2
author presentations explicitly discussing the same 2309.17043 reconstruction are supporting evidence only

published_generalized_EH_facts.paper_statement: the corresponding curvature term reduces to the classical one up to potential boundary terms

bulk_quotient_assumption.domain: boundaryless manifold or standard asymptotic/compact-support conditions such that integrated covariant Laplacians of scalars are boundary terms
bulk_quotient_assumption.consequence: For a purely linear-curvature term integral sqrt(g) F(Delta) R, analytic positive powers Delta^n R with n>=1 do not create independent bulk local coefficients after quotienting the classical EH term; they integrate to boundary terms under the declared conditions.
bulk_quotient_assumption.claim_boundary: This does not remove genuinely nonlinear curvature dependence in Rcal(Delta,R), nor nonanalytic/global boundary-sensitive structures.

excluded_shortcuts: count arbitrary functional freedom of Rcal as finite RQIR rank without a projection
recount R^2 or Ricci^2 form-factor coefficients
import p6/R3 structures excluded from F2 reconstruction
splice Lorentzian-spectral, essential-C3, KMQGB/polygon, or other lineages
information_firewall: No polygon-derived QGR equations, architecture, fitted parameters, or repairs are admitted.
